segments.label: Historical heading
segments.original:
CAP. XLVII.
BANDO
SOPRA LA SANITA’.

segments.label: Wider suspension in the Kingdom of Naples
segments.original: Presentendosi, che continuino il commercio con la Città di Napoli le Città, e luoghi del medesimo Regno, come anco quelli di Toscana, cioè Orbetello, Port’Ercole, Talamone, San Stefano, e Piombino col suo Stato, e l’Isola dell’Elba, perciò colle pene contenute nel Bando publicato li 20. del presente mese, si sospendono tutti li luoghi, Terre, e Città del Regno fin’à tanto che habbiano trasmesse le giustificationi della loro salute, e della prohibitione del commercio colla Città di Napoli, e venendone le giustificationi sudette si publicherà per Editto la reintegratione del commercio.
segments.english: Since it is reported that cities and places in the same Kingdom, and also those of Tuscany—namely Orbetello, Porto Ercole, Talamone, San Stefano, Piombino with its territory, and the island of Elba—continue dealings with Naples, all places, towns and cities of the Kingdom are suspended under the penalties contained in the proclamation published on the twentieth of this month, until they have sent documentation of their health and of their prohibition of dealings with Naples. When that documentation arrives, the restoration of dealings will be published by edict.

segments.label: Tuscan places and Portoferraio exception
segments.original: Si sospendono parimente colle medesime pene li luoghi sudetti di Toscana coll’Isola dell’Elba, eccettuatone Portoferraio, oue si gode buona salute, e s’è preuenuto col douuto riguardo.
segments.english: The aforesaid places in Tuscany and the island of Elba are likewise suspended under the same penalties, except Portoferraio, where good health prevails and due precautions have been taken.

segments.label: Provisions and safe handover at borders
segments.original: Non si prohibisce però la venuta dal Regno per le robbe non capaci di Contagio, come Animali viuenti, Vini, e Droghe in conformità dell’Editto publicato li 26. del presente. E quanto alle persone, che le conducessero, se non hauranno le necessarie giustificationi per l’ammissione, hauranno alli confini gli ordini opportuni per consegnare con sicurezza le robbe.
segments.english: The arrival from the Kingdom of goods regarded as incapable of carrying contagion, such as live animals, wines and spices, is not prohibited, in accordance with the edict published on the twenty-sixth of this month. If the people conveying them do not have the documentation necessary for admission, they will receive appropriate directions at the borders for handing over the goods safely.

notes.text: The twentieth- and twenty-sixth-of-May documents are reproduced in chapters 42 and 46. Restoration is conditional on documentation and a further edict; the chapter does not itself restore movement for every place.
The classification of goods as not capable of carrying contagion is the source’s historical claim. The border-handover provision distinguishes admission of goods from admission of their carriers.
